patches.subject: Profit Report: Shop | Fuel | Station — fuel margin per litre by grade, credit-ticket fuel counted once, cost frozen at shift close (for review)
patches.what: Profit Report shows Shop | Fuel | Station total. Fuel from closed shifts (metered litres × frozen price, every tender), cost per litre frozen on the readings at shift close (migration 13; earlier shifts use today's average cost and are marked estimated), shifts' cash short/over. Credit-ticket fuel already inside the stored shop revenue is moved to Fuel (only what the stored day really contains). Expenses taken once at station level. Fuel by grade with margin per litre; month to date station figures; A4 print updated. New GET /api/fuel-profit (Profit Report permissions). Stored shop figures unchanged.

patches.subject: HQ Consolidated Profit: Shop | Fuel | Station for every branch and the group, fuel margin per litre by grade across branches (for review)
patches.what: GET /api/hq/consolidated-profit adds each branch's fuel (services/fuelProfit with a day-by-day split; null where a branch has no forecourt) alongside the unchanged stored shop figures. Screen rebuilt: Group net profit (branches − HQ overhead once), group sales split shop/fuel, gross profit %, fuel margin per litre; by-branch table Shop sales | Fuel sales | Gross | Expenses | Net | Fuel/L with day drill-down; credit-ticket fuel counted once; shop-only branches marked; fuel by grade across branches. Money shown in full (was rounded to whole kwacha). No new endpoints, permissions, data or migrations.

patches.subject: UX-13: Cash Book — where the money is (Cash / MoMo / Bank), money in and out by day, transfers counted once, plain names, working export (for review)
patches.what: Cash Book on Kelete's K-only Cash/MoMo/Bank setup gets a new ledger view (ux/CashLedger.js): cash & cash equivalent with the Cash/MoMo/Bank split, each account opening → now; period strip money in (fuel takings shown), money out, moved between accounts, net; ledger grouped by day (in, out, closing) with plain names and icons; transfers shown once as 'moved', not in and out; filters (in, out, fuel, transfers, deposits) and search; quick periods load at once. Export now carries In/Out/Balance (the old export asked for usd_amount/fra_amount/k_amount, which rows don't have). Opening-balance confirm and error are in-app boxes (password step unchanged). Other currency setups keep the old view. No backend, data, permission or migration changes.

patches.subject: UX-14: Sales Report — calm headline, how customers paid, sales through the day, clearer rows with a quiet Reverse; fix Reset-to-today error (for review)
patches.what: Sales Report: kit header with the same exports and prints; quick periods with dates and cashier; invoice search on its own row; headline sales card (sales, reversed, average sale), How they paid (cash/MoMo/bank/on account bar), credit sales, discounts; new Through the day hourly chart with the busiest hour; transactions table Invoice | Date | Customer | Paid by | Total (discount under it) | Received (change under it) | Status, with quiet View/Reverse buttons; credit-note rows to match. Fixes the inherited Reset-to-today button, which called an undefined setDeviceFilter and threw before clearing the search. Reversals, credit notes, ZRA, duplicates, By item / By payment tabs, exports and prints unchanged. No backend, data, permission or migration changes.

patches.subject: Sales Report loads only the dates on screen (and searches on the server) instead of every order ever made (for review)
patches.what: GET /api/orders accepts optional from/to (a day wider each side; the screen still picks exact local days) and q (invoice search across all dates: our number, ZRA INV<sdc>/<rcpt>, CRN<sdc>/<rcpt>, raw receipt numbers; % and _ literal; max 500). Cost and partial-refund sums computed only for the selected orders. No parameters = every order, unchanged. Sales Report sends the dates on screen or the search, newest request wins. Measured on 20,000 sales: one day 132 KB / 27 ms instead of 37 MB / 940 ms. No data, permission or migration changes.

patches.subject: Fix: MoMo and Bank drawer expenses counted once, under their own method (Cash Report and voucher totals) (for review)
patches.what: Payment vouchers with amounts in their Cash/MoMo/Bank slots are read from the slots only. The old per-column fallback fired for empty slots on new vouchers and, because on a Kwacha book the method columns mirror the slots, counted a MoMo voucher under Bank too and a Bank voucher under MoMo — false 'Over' on the Cash Report's MoMo/Bank cards and wrong per-method voucher totals. Vouchers saved before the slots existed still use the old columns. Cash receipt totals not changed (written differently; to review separately). No data, permission or migration changes.

patches.subject: UX-15: Cash Report — blind count (counted boxes start empty, expected shown after counting), in-app confirm, kit header, readable colours (for review)
patches.what: Decision 2026-11-20: blind cash count on the Kwacha Cash/MoMo/Bank book. A new report's counted boxes start empty (were pre-filled with the expected amounts, so a report could be saved without counting and always balanced); each card shows its expected figure and Balanced/Over/Short only once its box is typed; the day's Total Expected and Difference tiles wait until the count is saved; Save asks for every shown method (0 allowed). Saved reports open as counted (a method saved as 0 shows 0). Auto-deposit confirmation is an in-app box. Kit header with day and cashier; differences shown as −K50.00; inherited contrast failures fixed. Other currency setups keep the pre-fill. No backend, data, permission or migration changes.

patches.subject: Fix: cash receipt totals count each receipt once per method on a Kwacha book (fuel day receipt was counted again as Bank) (for review)
patches.what: On a Kwacha book, cash receipts are read from their Cash/MoMo/Bank method columns whenever they have any, else from the usd/fra/k slots. The old slots-first reading counted the fuel day receipt's whole total again as Bank (its total lives in k_amount) and its bank swipes as MoMo, and swapped MoMo/Bank for customer-payment receipts: K1,830 of receipts read K2,780. Applied to GET /api/cash-receipts/stats and the Cash Receipt screen's rows, totals and edit form (ux/receiptModel.js). Multi-currency books unchanged. No data, permission or migration changes.

patches.subject: UX-16: Sales Inventory, Sales Stock Card, Sales Bin Card and VAT Report in the same look; K instead of $ in Sales Inventory (for review)
patches.what: Light reskin of the remaining Sales screens via one class (k-lg): dark kit page header, white stat cards with tinted icons, slate table headers, tabular figures; VAT report header band. Sales Inventory: Total Diff and Profit columns showed '$' (now K); inherited low-contrast text colours darkened. Markup and logic otherwise unchanged. No backend, data, permission or migration changes.

patches.subject: Docs: go-live checks expect schema version 13 after migrations 12 and 13 (for review)
patches.what: ops/go-live/README.md: the upgrade rehearsal, [migrate] log and schema-status checks now expect version 13 (migrations 12 and 13 were added after the README was written). No code changes.

patches.subject: UX-17: one theme across the app — slate neutrals, shared font stacks, money as K12.00 / −K12.00 everywhere, in-app boxes instead of browser pop-ups (for review)
patches.what: Frontend only. Every grey (Tailwind gray and one-off greys like #333, #ddd, #f5f5f5) mapped to the same step of the slate family the sidebar and new screens use; theme tokens in index.css (fonts, background, text) and kelete-ux.css; on-screen monospace uses one stack (Cascadia/Consolas instead of Courier); Inter 800 loaded. Money: shared formatters print K12,345.00 and −K12.00 (was "K 12,345.00" and "K -12.00"); Sales Inventory negatives show −K; GRN, SIV and Receivables prints show the till currency, not $. Browser alert/confirm replaced with in-app boxes on Sales Report, Cash Receipt, Sales Bin Card, POS checkout error, HQ Deposits, HQ GRN Archive and Payment Voucher. Sales Inventory header buttons in the shared hero colours.

patches.subject: Fix: Sales Report shows the over-collected split by currency again (tri-currency branches only) — dropped in UX-14 (for review)
patches.what: Final check before go-live (lint against the pre-session code: 0 new warnings after this). UX-14 kept the over-collected total on tri-currency branches but lost its USD / FRA / K split, leaving three unused totals. The split is shown again. Kelete (K-only) never shows over-collected, so nothing changes there.
